comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body:
No problem! I forgot some info earlier anyway. To repost! According to gvo.gamedb.info's university section, this thesis and its 1-star research building cousin -- Full/Drunk Rate Decrease -- have the following requirements:

R5 Cooking and/or R3 Wining & Dining
Completion of The town's top cook

50 pages needed for thesis completion, 150 credits awarded per thesis, 3500 credits needed to equip the skill. 5 thesis pages given for course meals, 1 page for "field activities", or acquiring trade goods via procurement, collection, and fishing. I do find fishing was the quickest way, at least for me.
